state:
**Goal `plain-comments` is reached.** Both of its checks pass:
`bun nv proofs --comments docs/examples tests/hostile benches/members` exits 0, and
`bun nv proofs --gate` says nothing is owed in the whole roster.

The last red sweep was the host again, not the tree. Docker Desktop was not running at all, so
`nvs queue migrate --connection main` found nothing at `127.0.0.1:15432`. `docker desktop start`
and `docker compose -f tests/db/compose.yaml up -d --wait postgres redis` brought the servers back,
and the check now prints `jobs: applied` and `dead_letter: applied`. The WSL distro
`Ubuntu-24.04` starts.

`bun nv verify --doc` resolves every link, and `bun nv owners --closes plain-comments` and
`bun nv playbook --closes plain-comments` name nothing. The tree is unchanged since `fd3ff788e`.
